title: A screen reader announces the results count when it changes
An exact identifier match is pinned as a single row at the very top
On a Customer page, that customer's assets and work orders are boosted
On a Work Order page, parts already on that work order are pushed down
A contact-field match scores as a secondary-field match on its company
Customers with an open work order and recently viewed rank higher
Assets with an open work order (and recently viewed) rank higher
Vendors with open purchase orders (and recently used) rank higher
Recent part sales, yours, and paid ones rank higher
Recently sold and recently viewed parts rank higher
A customer with more open work orders ranks above one with fewer
A result matched on its name ranks above one matched only on a secondary field
An exact identifier match is pinned at the very top even when a strong name match exists
Recent-entities API records views and serves a deduped, permission-filtered list
Searching the in-page Work Orders list filters the list, with the term in the search box
Clearing the in-page Work Orders search restores the full list
A search failure shows the 'Search unavailable, retry' banner
A technician WITHOUT Parts access does NOT see Parts results
A user WITHOUT Work Orders access does NOT see Work Order results
An entity type with no accessible records shows no group (and its scope tab shows the empty state)
Permission bundles hide whole groups, their counts and tabs; prices masked without financial access
The recent-searches list only shows records the person can currently access
Typing the exact number of a record you cannot access does not surface it (no pinned top hit)
A contact-field match is hidden when you cannot access its parent company
A role missing several access areas hides all of them together and keeps the rest
A typo search does not leak a record you cannot access
Flipping only Parts access shows then hides the same part in search
Flipping only Work Orders access shows then hides the same work order
Flipping only Customers access shows then hides the same customer and its vehicle
Flipping only Part Sales access shows then hides the same part sale
Flipping only Vendor & Order Management access hides the same vendor, PO and invoice
Removing See Financial Data hides the total on a Vendor invoice row but keeps the row
Records a person cannot see are not counted in any heading, tab or total
Old global-search path is removed on direct rollout (no feature flag)
Purchase Orders searchable; real number format; Receive quick action
Vendor Invoices are searchable with a tri-state payment badge and no quick action
Vendor results appear only with Vendor & Order Management access
An unrecognised result type is hidden unless explicitly permitted
Recent items the user can no longer access are hidden
Results never include another organization's records
Selecting the record you are already on does not re-navigate
Global search is available with no feature-flag toggle
A newly created customer is findable within 30 seconds
A new work order or part sale is findable within 30 seconds
